content:
maria: Heads-up — planning a short deploy for router config + observability tweaks at 22:00 UTC today (5m window). Changes: swap heatmap panel to the new latency histogram, lower P95 alert from 600ms -> 450ms for prod. Owners: @kevin (dash), @sasha (alerts), @emily (runbook). Please ack if you can take the pieces.
kevin: Ack, I’ll update the heatmap query and add per-route breakdown. Also going to raise trace sampling from 1% -> 5% for 10m after deploy to validate tail behavior. :eyes:
sasha: I’ll set a temporary cooldown policy for the P95 alert while sampling is elevated. Will also tune the alert to require sustained 2m violation before firing.
emily: Rollback plan is ready and linked in the runbook. Quick smoke checklist added below.
```
# Smoke checklist (short)
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY'
2) ./tools/smoke-check.sh --route model-router-v2 --count 30 --qcache 0
3) Confirm heatmap p95 < 600ms and no increase in errors
```
kevin: Updated smoke script — new sample command: ./tools/smoke-check.sh --route model-router-v2 --count 50 --verbose. I’ll push dash PR and link it here when ready.
maria: Great. If anyone expects a blocker, call it out by 21:40 UTC; otherwise I’ll kick at 22:00. I’ll be online for post-deploy monitoring. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #deploy-455 at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z. Notifying oncall. ETA ~5m.
kevin: Dash PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inc/observability/pull/842 — includes query and new histogram panel.
sasha: Cooldown rule applied and test-suppressed for the next 15m around deploy window. I’ll re-enable 10m after sampling ends.
emily: Rollback doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/ROLLBACK-23 — contains exact commands to restore previous routing config and kill the canary. I’ll stand by to execute if smoke fails.
maria: Thanks — once deploy is done post the smoke run results and a link to a sample trace (trace ID or link). If everything looks good we’ll promote the change to the wider fleet tomorrow.
kevin: Will paste smoke output and a short grafana snapshot after checks.
sasha: I’ll watch alerts and mute if we get noisy false positives during sampling.
emily: I’ll be on standby in the thread for rollback trigger.
maria: Perfect — team acknowledged. Proceeding unless I hear blockers by 21:40.
